snippet.title: Voyage to the Sunken City Announcement Video
snippet.description:
Game Designers Cora, Edward, and Leo start the exploration of what’s new to Hearthstone in the latest card set, twelve new cards, and some important nautical terms. Voyage to the Sunken City will launch worldwide on April 12, with 135 new cards, the new Naga minion type, new Dredge and Colossal keywords, sunken cards, and more!  

Learn more about Voyage to the Sunken City: https://blizz.ly/3CbY3rY 
Read the 22.6 Patch Notes: https://blizz.ly/3KiOQ3S
